about: THE Q128 ARCHITECTURE AUDIT RECORD (docs/design/BUSBAR-1.6.0.md l.2910-2912, DEV-GREEN item 5; 1.6.0-QUESTIONS.md Q128, owner 2026-10-01, option A): one fresh, independent architecture audit on the DEV-GREEN candidate sha, graded against the Laws and THE DESIGN; it passes with no open BLOCK findings and a clean audit ledger. The auditor writes `candidate` (the 40-hex commit read), `auditor`, and one entry per finding: id, severity (BLOCK, HIGH, MEDIUM or LOW), status (open or closed; a closed finding names the change that closed it in closed_by), scope, title, evidence (path:line and what it shows) and cite (the Law or DESIGN line it is graded against). `cargo xtask q128 audit` judges this record and the audit ledger on the current tree, writes target/q128-audit.json, and exits 1 on any open BLOCK. `candidate` is null until the audit is made.
